description: Year-end organizational review and planning for 2015. Discussion of research priorities and operational developments.

attachments.text: Minutes	  for	  the	  December	  16,	  2014	  meeting	  of	  the	  Clear	  Fund	  (aka	  GiveWell)	  Board	  of	  Directors	  	  	  	  	  00:00:00	  Meeting	  called	  to	  order	  	  	  00:00:40	  Board	  discusses	  the	  2014	  expected	  budget	  and	  actual	  expenses	  including	  reasons	  for	  discrepancies	  between	  the	  two.	  	  00:04:00	  Board	  discusses	  the	  proposed	  2015	  budget.	  	  00:05:00	  Board	  discusses	  the	  plans	  and	  budget	  for	  new	  GiveWell	  and	  Open	  Philanthropy	  Project	  website.	  	  00:14:30	  Board	  discusses	  the	  relationship	  between	  GiveWell,	  Good	  Ventures,	  and	  funding	  for	  the	  Open	  Philanthropy	  Project.	  	  33:40	  Board	  votes	  on	  proposed	  2015	  budget.	  	  	  The	  budget	  is	  approved.	  	  	  00:34:20	  The	  co-­‐Executive	  Directors	  update	  the	  board	  on	  the	  progress	  of	  GiveWell	  and	  the	  Open	  Philanthropy	  Project	  as	  well	  as	  plans	  for	  2015.	  	  01:01:01	  The	  meeting	  is	  adjourned
